post.description:
Perform a filtered search for categories.

**Available Associations:**
- `children` - Child categories within this category for hierarchical navigation
- `media` - Category image or banner
- `tags` - Tags for organizing and filtering categories
- `cmsPage` - CMS page layout for the category
- `seoUrls` - SEO-friendly URLs for the category across different sales channels

parameters.name: sw-include-search-info
parameters.description: Controls whether API search information is included in the response. Default is 1 (enabled), will be 0 (disabled) in the next major version.

400.description: The `Criteria` sent with the request is invalid, e.g. an unknown filter field, sorting field or association.

post.description:
This endpoint returns information about the category, as well as a fully resolved (hydrated with mapping values) CMS page, if one is assigned to the category. You can pass slots which should be resolved exclusively.

**Available Associations:**
- `children` - Child categories within this category for hierarchical navigation
- `media` - Category image or banner
- `tags` - Tags for organizing and filtering categories
- `cmsPage` - CMS page layout for the category
- `seoUrls` - SEO-friendly URLs for the category across different sales channels

parameters.name: sw-include-seo-urls
parameters.description: Instructs Shopware to try and resolve SEO URLs for the given navigation item

parameters.name: sw-include-search-info
parameters.description: Controls whether API search information is included in the response. Default is 1 (enabled), will be 0 (disabled) in the next major version.

parameters.name: navigationId
parameters.description: Identifier of the category to be fetched

parameters.name: slots
parameters.description: Resolves only the given slot identifiers. The identifiers have to be seperated by a '|' character

200.description: The loaded category with cms page

404.description: The category does not exist, is not reachable in this sales channel, or the CMS page assigned to it was not found.
